def binres(n,nb=18):
    tot=0
    edges=np.linspace(0.5,10,nb+1)
    out=[]
    for i in range(nb):
        m=(t>=edges[i])&(t<edges[i+1])
        tc=t[m].mean()
        x=A[m]**n; yy=y[m]; dt=t[m]-tc
        X=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x),dt,x,x*dt])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,yy,rcond=None)
        r=yy-X@c
        tot+=np.sum(r**2)
        out.append((round(tc,2),np.round(c[2],3)))
    return tot/np.sum((y-y.mean())**2), out
